title: Duplicate bg values ​​used 3.0 beta1
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------

Duplicate bg values ​​used 3.0 beta1 and this disrupts the whole algorithm as it does not detect a drop or increase but a straight line attached to a screenshot and logs
![Screenshot_20211028-141203](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73236490/139245071-dcfd8bc5-895b-41ea-8763-95090f5b495e.png)

comments.body:
this is caused by xdrip or dexcom bridge in NS
it's a bug in your setup.
Keep only one app (preferably AAPS) upload BG to NS

Thank you so much,
 I also wanted to update that I am running it with Omnipod Dash with phone
kingkong mini 2 and it works great with 100% good communication
